title: FPF Prediction Log Record
description: Per-prediction record for Brier score calibration analysis. Agents append one record per line in JSONL format. External tools consume this file to compute Brier score, reliability, resolution, and skill.

session_id.description: Session in which this prediction was made

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when prediction was made

predicted_probability.description: Agent's confidence in the prediction (0.0 = certain false, 1.0 = certain true)

actual_outcome.description: Whether the prediction was correct. null if oracle has not yet resolved.

evidence_tag.description: Evidence maturity of the claim at prediction time

domain.description: Cynefin domain classification at prediction time

depth_tier.description: FPF depth tier at prediction time

resolution_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when oracle resolved. null if not yet resolved.

resolution_latency_seconds.description: Seconds between prediction and resolution. null if not yet resolved.
